body.name: unconditional effective elimination schedule
body.construction: Set \(B_2(n)=U_2(n)=2\cdot8^{2^{n(n+1)}}\).  Run \(DBI\) once through its complete internal weighted-degree loop at cutoff \(B_2(n)\), disable every finite wall-clock timeout, and retain either the exact identifying formulas or the complete exact negative bounded-search certificate.
